Definition: Achashverosh (i.e. Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king
BiblicalUsage: Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor"; 1) title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
